c_page_sub: Keep your provider details and every complaint in one place, then hand them over with your monthly report.
c_profile_sub: Shown at the top of the monthly report. Stays on this computer.
c_plan_hint: The speed your contract promises. The report compares your speed tests with it.
c_empty: No complaints yet. When you call your provider, write down the complaint number here.
c_ticket_ph: The number the agent gave you
c_notes_ph: What happened, what they promised, when they said it would be fixed…
c_delete_body: It will be removed from this list and from future reports.
c_overdue: More than 72 hours have passed with no fix. You can escalate to the regulator now.
c_err_ticket: Enter the complaint number or a note
c_guide_1: Complain to your provider first (hotline, app or branch) and write down the complaint number, date and agent name.
c_guide_2: Give them 72 hours. Keep Internet Monitor running so every drop in that time is recorded.
c_guide_3: If it isn't fixed, escalate to the National Telecom Regulatory Authority (NTRA): call 155, use the My NTRA app, or its online complaints portal. Have your landline number and the provider's complaint number ready.
c_guide_4: Attach the monthly report (print it to PDF) or the evidence pack. The pack contains the raw logs and a SHA-256 checksum for every file so anyone can confirm nothing was edited.
c_guide_note: Outside Egypt the steps are similar: complain to the provider, then to your country's telecom regulator.
